name: Trusted Cover
summary: She takes less damage while the commander is exposed.

name: Follow-Up
summary: After an ally's crit she strikes the same target for half damage (once per round).

name: Confidant Sync
summary: Orders aimed at her cost 1 less CP.

name: Kindred Sync
summary: Each round she calms herself a little and, less so, her squadmates.

name: Shield Body
summary: +15% damage while the commander is exposed.

name: Devoted Sacrifice
summary: Once per combat she takes a lethal hit meant for the commander.

name: Grudging Obedience
summary: 15% chance to refuse an order aimed at her.

name: Open Resentment
summary: 25% chance to refuse an order aimed at her.

name: Defiance
summary: 35% chance to refuse an order aimed at her.
